_comment: Known built-in slash commands / bundled skills for agent CLIs (Claude Code, Copilot CLI). Used as the last-resort fallback in the Skill Usage tab when a skill name has no discoverable SKILL.md anywhere (open workspace or historical workspace) — these are baked into the CLI binary itself, not a project/user SKILL.md file, so no description can ever be found on disk for them.
add-dir: Built-in: add a working directory for file access during the current session.
advisor: Built-in (Claude Code): enable or disable the advisor tool for guidance at key moments.
agent: Built-in (Copilot CLI): select a custom Copilot agent.
agent-merge: Bundled skill (GitHub Copilot app): once a PR is open, automatically responds to reviewer comments, fixes failing checks, and merges when your defined conditions (review, tests, merge conditions) are met.
background: Built-in (Claude Code): detach the current session to run as a background agent.
bg: Built-in (Claude Code): detach the current session to run as a background agent.
branch: Built-in (Claude Code): create a branch of the current conversation to try a different direction.
btw: Built-in (Claude Code): ask a quick side question without adding to the conversation.
cd: Built-in (Claude Code): move the session to a new working directory.
chrome: Built-in (Claude Code): configure Claude in Chrome settings.
chronicle: Built-in (Copilot CLI): turns session history into standup summaries, personalized tips, and custom-instruction suggestions across Copilot cloud agent, code review, the GitHub Copilot app, VS Code, and JetBrains sessions.
clear: Built-in: clear conversation history/session state and start fresh.
color: Built-in (Claude Code): set the prompt bar color for the current session.
compact: Built-in: summarize the conversation to free up context/memory.
config: Built-in (Claude Code): open the Settings interface or set preferences directly.
context: Built-in: show current token/context usage and available buffer.
copy: Built-in (Claude Code): copy the last assistant response to clipboard.
cost: Built-in: show API/session usage and costs.
create-canvas: Bundled skill (GitHub Copilot app): opens a shared, interactive surface (plan, triage board, browser session, dashboard, etc.) that both you and the agent can edit — the agent updates it live while working.
cwd: Built-in (Copilot CLI): confirm or change the current working directory.
debug: Built-in: enable debug logging and troubleshoot runtime issues.
delegate: Built-in (Copilot CLI): delegate changes as a pull request in a remote repository.
desktop: Built-in (Claude Code): continue the current session in the Claude Code Desktop app.
diff: Built-in (Claude Code): open an interactive diff viewer showing uncommitted changes.
doctor: Built-in (Claude Code): run a setup checkup that diagnoses and fixes issues.
effort: Built-in (Claude Code): set the model reasoning-effort level.
exit: Built-in: end/exit the current CLI session.
export: Built-in (Claude Code): export the current conversation as plain text.
fast: Built-in (Claude Code): toggle fast mode on or off.
feedback: Built-in: send product feedback about the CLI.
focus: Built-in (Claude Code): toggle the focus view showing only essential information.
fork: Built-in (Claude Code): copy the current conversation into a new background session.
goal: Built-in (Claude Code): set a goal for Claude to keep working until a condition is met.
help: Built-in: show help and list available commands.
heapdump: Built-in (Claude Code): write a JavaScript heap snapshot for diagnosing memory usage.
hooks: Built-in (Claude Code): view hook configurations for tool events.
ide: Built-in (Claude Code): manage IDE integrations and show status.
impeccable: Bundled skill (GitHub Copilot app): a design-quality partner with 23 commands and 44 rules that catches issues like poor contrast, misaligned elements, inconsistent spacing, and accessibility failures.
init: Built-in (Claude Code): initialize the project with a CLAUDE.md guide.
insights: Built-in (Claude Code): generate a report analyzing your Claude Code sessions.
keybindings: Built-in (Claude Code): open your keyboard shortcuts file.
list-dirs: Built-in (Copilot CLI): list directories Copilot can access.
login: Built-in: sign in to your account (Anthropic / GitHub).
logout: Built-in: sign out of your account (Anthropic / GitHub).
memory: Built-in (Claude Code): edit CLAUDE.md memory files and manage auto-memory.
mobile: Built-in (Claude Code): show a QR code to download the Claude mobile app.
model: Built-in: switch the active AI model for this CLI session.
new: Built-in (Claude Code): start a new conversation with empty context.
permissions: Built-in (Claude Code): set your approval rules for Claude actions.
plan: Built-in (Claude Code): switch into plan mode before a large change.
quit: Built-in: end/exit the current CLI session.
reset: Built-in (Claude Code): start a new conversation with empty context.
reset-allowed-tools: Built-in (Copilot CLI): reset allowed external tools.
resume: Built-in: return to / resume an earlier conversation.
rewind: Built-in (Claude Code): roll code and conversation back to a checkpoint.
review: Built-in (Claude Code): give a fast single-pass, read-only review of a GitHub PR.
security-review: Built-in (Claude Code): check the diff for security vulnerabilities.
session: Built-in (Copilot CLI): show the current session and usage stats.
settings: Built-in (Claude Code): open the Settings interface or set preferences directly.
share: Built-in (Copilot CLI): share the session as markdown or a GitHub Gist.
status: Built-in (Claude Code): show current session status.
tasks: Built-in (Claude Code): list the current session's background work and subagents.
teleport: Built-in (Claude Code): pull a web session into this terminal.
terminal-setup: Built-in: enable multiline inputs for complex instructions.
theme: Built-in (Copilot CLI): manage terminal output theme preferences.
user: Built-in (Copilot CLI): manage GitHub account selection and switching.
batch: Bundled skill (Claude Code): orchestrate large-scale changes across a codebase in parallel using independent git worktrees.
claude-api: Bundled skill (Claude Code): load Claude API reference material and Managed Agents documentation.
code-review: Bundled skill (Claude Code): review the current diff for correctness bugs and cleanup opportunities.
dataviz: Bundled skill (Claude Code): design guidance for charts, graphs, and dashboards.
deep-research: Bundled skill (Claude Code): fan out web searches on a question and synthesize a cited report.
design-sync: Bundled skill (Claude Code): convert your repo's React design system and upload it to Claude Design.
design-login: Bundled skill (Claude Code): authorize design-system access for design-sync.
fewer-permission-prompts: Bundled skill (Claude Code): scan transcripts and add an allowlist to reduce permission prompts.
loop: Bundled skill (Claude Code): run a prompt repeatedly on a schedule or with self-pacing.
proactive: Bundled skill (Claude Code): run a prompt repeatedly on a schedule or with self-pacing.
autofix-pr: Bundled skill (Claude Code): spawn a Claude Code on the web session that watches a PR and pushes fixes.
install-github-app: Bundled skill (Claude Code): install the Claude GitHub App for a repository.
install-slack-app: Bundled skill (Claude Code): install the Claude Slack app.
